event.message: Launching a fresh browser: 1280×800, no cookies, not signed in.
Opened the product page. A popup appeared without any action from me.
Reading the popup with Gemini (gemini-3.6-flash)…
Declined the popup ("No thanks, I prefer paying full price").
Staying on the page for 8 s, like a shopper reading the details.
Looking up this product's price history in the demo catalog…
13 weeks of prices: sold at ₹1,499–₹1,599; MRP ₹1,999 until 7 days ago, ₹3,999 since.
62% discount is calculated off an MRP raised 7 days ago.

finding.title: 62% discount is calculated off an MRP raised 7 days ago
finding.explanation: The page advertises ₹1,499 as 62% off an MRP of ₹3,999. Over the last 13 weeks the product sold at ₹1,499–₹1,599 and never at ₹3,999; the MRP was raised from ₹1,999 to ₹3,999 7 days ago. Against the highest price it really sold at (₹1,599), the discount is 6%.

rule.clause: Sec. 2(28) misleading advertisement; Sec. 2(47) unfair trade practice

evidence.elementText: Festive Sale price ₹1,499 MRP ₹3,999 62% off Inclusive of all taxes
observations: Advertised: ₹1,499, MRP ₹3,999 (62% off)
Last 13 weeks: sold at ₹1,499–₹1,599, never at ₹3,999
MRP changed ₹1,999 → ₹3,999, 7 days ago
Discount against the highest real price (₹1,599): 6%

finding.remediation: Quote discounts against a price the product actually sold at (such as ₹1,599), not the ₹3,999 MRP.

event.message: Reloading the page for a second look.
Reading the product page with Gemini (gemini-3.6-flash)…
Manipulative wording on decline option
Countdown timer restarts on every page load.

finding.title: Countdown timer restarts on every page load
finding.explanation: The countdown read 09:51 on the first look. Straight after a reload it read 09:59. A real deadline cannot move later, so this timer restarts per visit and the urgency it creates is false.

rule.source: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023

observations: Before reload: 09:51
After reload: 09:59
The deadline moved later, which a real end time cannot do

finding.remediation: Give the offer a fixed end date and time, or drop the countdown; it must not restart on a reload.

event.message: Choosing colour: Pearl White.
"Only 2 left" never changes.

finding.title: "Only 2 left" never changes
finding.explanation: The scarcity badge shows the same count on first load, after a reload and after switching to another variant. Different variants normally carry separate stock, so an identical count everywhere points to a fixed message, not live inventory.

rule.source: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023

observations: Read on 3 looks: "Hurry, only 2 left in stock!" every time
Looks taken: first load, after a reload, after a variant change

finding.remediation: Show the real stock count for each variant, updated as it changes, or remove the scarcity message.

event.message: Added 1 × SonicBuds Pro ANC Wireless Earbuds to the cart. Opening the cart.
1-Year Accidental Damage Protection added to the cart without consent.

finding.title: 1-Year Accidental Damage Protection added to the cart without consent
finding.explanation: The agent added exactly 1 item to the cart. The cart then held 2 lines: "1-Year Accidental Damage Protection" (₹199) had been added automatically. The shopper never ticked, chose or was asked about it.

rule.source: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023

evidence.elementText: 1-Year Accidental Damage Protection 12 months · Sold by BazaarNest Care ₹199 REMOVE
observations: Added by the agent: 1 line (SonicBuds Pro ANC Wireless Earbuds)
Found in cart: 2 lines
Extra line: 1-Year Accidental Damage Protection, ₹199
Cart total ₹1,698

finding.remediation: Don't put "1-Year Accidental Damage Protection" in the cart for the shopper; offer it as an unticked option.

event.message: Reading the cart with Gemini (gemini-3.6-flash)…
Checkout asks me to sign in. I have no account for this site, so I stopped here rather than create one.
Confirmed "Manipulative wording on decline option" (confidence 0.95).

finding.title: Manipulative wording on decline option
finding.explanation: The opt-out link text 'No thanks, I prefer paying full price' uses guilt-inducing language to make shoppers feel foolish for turning down the discount.

rule.source: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023

frames.caption: The popup, as the shopper saw it

evidence.elementText: No thanks, I prefer paying full price
observations: Popup button: "No thanks, I prefer paying full price" (text link, grey text, 12 px, 198×16 px)

finding.remediation: Change the decline option text to a neutral phrase like 'No thanks'.

event.message: Unverifiable popularity claim
Nothing on the page can confirm or refute this claim. Sending it to human review.

finding.title: Unverifiable popularity claim
finding.explanation: The claim '🔥 120+ bought in the last 24 hours' creates purchase pressure based on popularity data that cannot be verified by the shopper on this page.

rule.source: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023

frames.caption: The popup, as the shopper saw it

observations: Claim: "🔥 120+ bought in the last 24 hours"

finding.remediation: Remove the unverified purchase count claim or provide a verifiable real-time data source.

event.message: Asymmetric styling favoring offer acceptance
Nothing on the cart needs flagging beyond what was measured.
"Unlock my 10% off" takes up 4.2× the space of "No thanks, I prefer paying full price", with 1.17× the font size.
Confirmed "Asymmetric styling favoring offer acceptance" (confidence 0.90).

finding.title: Asymmetric styling favoring offer acceptance
finding.explanation: The store-preferred action 'Unlock my 10% off' is styled as a prominent 336x40 px filled dark teal button, while the alternative 'No thanks, I prefer paying full price' is deemphasized as a small 12 px grey text link.

rule.source: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023

frames.caption: The popup, as the shopper saw it

evidence.elementText: Unlock my 10% off · No thanks, I prefer paying full price
observations: Popup button: "Unlock my 10% off" (filled button, dark teal, 14 px bold, 336×40 px)
Popup button: "No thanks, I prefer paying full price" (text link, grey text, 12 px, 198×16 px)

finding.remediation: Provide the decline option with visual prominence comparable to the accept button.

report.summary: 6 violations confirmed across 2 of the 3 reachable journey steps, and 1 claim sent for human review. The amount payable rose from ₹1,499 on the product page to ₹1,698 (+13%). Checkout and Payment could not be audited: sign-in required.
